title: Crown Collectibles
tagline: Experience the royal treatment with our exclusive royalty program and collectable Dynamic NFTs
description: We are working on end-to-end user spotting, distribution, user retention, and incentivization of users based on their on-chain and off-chain activity. We think of ourselves as a complete advertisement stack for Web3, where we help projects to connect with their potential clients and vice versa.
how_its_made: We faced many hurdles in the way most difficult being working with IPFS IPNS and  biconomy  SDK integration. Our team's stack is python so JS SDKs were a bit tricky. But nonetheless, we made it through.
